description: Synthetic sample merchant, not a real customer. Deliberately structured differently from configs/cardcorp.json -- different column names, a different Expiry date format (MM/YYYY vs. CardCorp's YYYY-MM), and a different repair field length -- to prove the staging service generalizes across schemas rather than only reproducing CardCorp's. See production/sample_data/samplepay_raw.csv and test_staging_service.py's test_transform_for_different_schema().
